column4: A sky texture for a 1990s Build-engine game skybox (Redneck Rampage, Blood), painted in exactly the same fine pixel style, palette and small pixel size as the reference: fine painted detail, thin one-pixel streaks of cloud, smooth banded gradients, NOT chunky or blocky. The western sky just after the sun has gone down on an autumn evening, a surreal blood-red sky: a glowing band of hot orange and gold low along the horizon in the middle, above it deep crimson and scarlet, high up a dark wine red going to maroon, long thin torn streaks of cloud lit fiery orange and red from below, darker crimson on top, eerie and beautiful. No sun disc, no trees, no ground, no text, no frame, the horizon is the bottom edge, seamless left to right.
